notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
After reading a few reviews, we've come to realize that Shatter is a bit too difficult, so we made a few changes to it! We also fixed a few bugs.

[h1]Shatter:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Removed 2 rows from both the top and bottom
    [*]Removed 3 columns from both left and right side
    [*]Capping speed with 2 shuttles so you have more reaction time
    [*]Fixed a bug where completing Shatter stages didn't properly work
[/list]


[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Achievements will be awarded retroactively if you already got them (applies to all but Survive at the moment). However, if you get the in-game achievement, you should be awarded the steam achievement for ANY of the achievements, including Survive achievements.
[/list]


[h1]Coming changes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Remove blocks from the middle of Shatter, making the logo light up the color of the ball, just like Survive. 
[/list]


Hope you like the changes, and if you have any more feedback, hit us up in the discussion section!
